# Python Integration

This layer handles Python-related tasks and structures.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for analyzing, verifying, and managing Python source code. It includes utilities for parsing, processing comments, and managing folder structures.

## Responsibilities

- **Comment Processing**: Manages and processes comments within Python files.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/analyze.js`](../src/analyze.js) | Analyzes lines and provides line indices and token matches. | `analyzeLines`, `lineIndexAt`, `lineStarts`, `matchToken`, `splitLines`, `baseInfo` |
| [`src/folders.js`](../src/folders.js) | Manages folder structures and purposes. | `FOLDER_SCHEMA`, `MAX_FILES_PER_CALL`, `callLabel`, `callTokens`, `dirOf`, `digestLine` |
| [`src/importance.js`](../src/importance.js) | Orders files based on complexity and import specifiers. | `complexity`, `importSpecifiers`, `importersOf`, `isEntryPoint`, `nameUsage`, `packageEntries` |
| [`src/process.js`](../src/process.js) | Manages comment processing and deadlines. | `DOCS_PASS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `DOCS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `README_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `deadlines`, `docsReserveMinutes`, `docsToRewrite` |
| [`src/python-helper.py`](../src/python-helper.py) | Analyzes and verifies Python source for Docturnal. | `analyze`, `dump`, `env_names`, `targets`, `verify`, `main` |
| [`src/python.js`](../src/python.js) | Runs src/python-helper.py with python3 to analyze and verify Python source. | `analyzePython`, `findPython`, `pythonEnvNames`, `runHelper`, `verifyPython` |
| [`src/structure.js`](../src/structure.js) | Analyzes the structure of files. | `commentPurpose`, `fileStructure`, `leadingComment`, `structuralSummary`, `symbolsOf`, `basename` |

## How it works

- **src/analyze.js**: This file provides functions to analyze lines of Python code, including finding token matches and managing line indices.
- **src/python-helper.py**: This Python script analyzes and verifies Python source code using the `analyze` function.
- **src/structure.js**: This file analyzes the structure of Python files, including identifying comments and symbols.
